newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka Spence up on growth in tourism.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka Spence up on growth in tourism.

text.p: Shares of Sri Lankan blue chip Aitken Spence & Co Ltd rose 8.1 percent or 15 rupees to 200, on retail buying on Wednesday, brokers said. "The share, which is expected to see good growth due to improved tourism, is still trading at a discount," said Alastair Corera of Forbes and Walker Stock Brokers.
Tourist arrivals are expected to rise in 1997 compared to 1996, due to improved security in Colombo and the suburbs, brokers said.
Aitken Spence is a conglomerate largely exposed to the tourist industry.
